title: Cap. X Arg. V Minor close: Augustine Tract. 105 — the Son is glorified so as to make the Father known to all given him; being given to Christ (that is, elected) is prior to knowing
pass_a_gloss: Let us hear the same Augustine whom we heard before; So he glorifies the Son, that unto all whom thou hast given him he may make thee known, Tract. 105. in Evang. Joann. It is therefore prior to be given unto Christ by the Father, that is to be elected, than to know.
pass_b_english: Hear again the same Augustine: So he glorifies the Son, that to all whom you have given him he may make you known (Tract. 105. on John's Gospel). Therefore being given to Christ by the Father — that is, being elected — is prior to knowing.
source_text: Audiamus eundem quem antea audivimus Augustinum; Sic se Filium glorificat, ut omnibus quos dedisti ei te cognitum faciat, Tract. 105. in Evang. Joann. Est igitur prius Christo donari a Patre, hoc est eligi, quam cognoscere.
